messages:
maria: perf-bot just flagged the nightly kernel-candidates job as flaky — job: nightly-kernel-candidates-1912345678
perf-bot: job=nightly-kernel-candidates status=FAIL reason=flakiness_spike suite=microbench-v2 details: 95p_latency_jump
jen: saw it. failing pattern looks tied to longseq + KV-cold + batch=8 on avx2. microbench mean looks fine but end-to-end e2e runs show spikes (2/10 runs)
sam: can you paste the failing trace/log snippet?
jen: ```
[2026-03-16T04:12:03Z] evict: kv_idx=1024 seq=2048 latency=12.3ms -> spike=230.1ms
TRACE: kernel=candidateX arch=avx2 path=seqlen>1024 batch=8 prefetch=async
STACK: runtime/kv_cache.go:217 prefetch_worker
```
liam: that matches a race we've seen before. candidate kernel passes microbench microprobe (isolated kernels) but when KV cache is cold and batching/backpressure kicks in we see large tail latency.
maria: i repro locally with harness: `./harness --kernel candidateX --seq 2048 --batch 8 --kv-size 16 --runs 20` — i get 3/20 spikes
az: (note: oz not used)
oz: hmm our gating is too permissive. current gate = mean_latency < baseline*1.1 && p95 < baseline*2. We need a stability metric, not just means.
sam: proposal: new gating rules: require p95 < 1.5x baseline AND (p95/p50) < 1.2 AND fail_rate <= 1/20 for candidate promotion. Also add targeted kv-cold sweep to nightly.
jen: +1. also add an explicit harness flag `--kv-cold` to force eviction patterns so microbench covers this scenario.
perf-bot: created PERF-2374: "candidateX flakiness under KV-cold; add kv-cold sweep + gating" assigned_to=jen priority=high
maria: i'll update the benchmark harness to emit stability metrics (p50, p95, cv, fail_rate) and JSON output so CI can automatically gate on them. API: `--emit-metrics-json out.json`
liam: small rollout: run new gating in canary CI for 2 weeks (nightly), if clean then flip in autotune pipeline. This lets us catch false positives.
sam: i'll add a unit/integration test to exercise async prefetch paths and try to make the race deterministic. tagging @jen for the fix.
jen: assigned. plan: add atomic prefetch guard + small sleep on eviction to reduce races. will re-run harness and post results.
perf-bot: rerun nightly for candidateX: 4/20 runs -> 3 pass, 1 flaky -> status=FLAKY (fail_rate=5%)
maria: OK block candidateX from promotion until we see fail_rate <=1/20 and p95 within 1.5x baseline. create PR with gating and harness flags.
sam: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/12345 — includes `--kv-cold`, JSON metrics and gating logic in CI job `autotune-gate-v2`
oz: good catch. also add a short note in eng-runtime/README about KV-cold regression class so future candidates are tested by default.
maria: thanks all — follow-up: if candidateX fix lands, we should run a focused nightly sweep across archs (avx2, avx512, h100) with kv-cold + multi-batch matrix. I'll file a sweep job. :eyes:
